notes.title: Doodle Factory Special Machine Update
notes.content:
[h1]What’s new?[/h1]

[h2]Special Machines[/h2]
These Special Machines are available from Tier 2 and above boards. These are placed upon the generation of the board. It will assist you on your automation!

[h2]Endgame Upgrades[/h2]
Hub can be upgraded indefinitely to multiply the resources you receive.
Unlock the Monolith Board to enhance the endgame experience.

[h2]Quality of Life[/h2]
[list]
[*] You can now hover on the storage of the resources to view how much you gain per second of that resource.
[*] Windowed mode can now be resized at your own resolution
[*] Number notation is now used for the resources
        k = 1,000
        m = 1,000,000
        b = 1,000,000,000
[*] Controls are now shown on the lower left of the screen
[*] Confirmation screen on deleting a board
[/list]
[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Bug fix on moving and switching boards causes big spike in FPS
[*] Tutorial jump fix on trying to switch the board at the beginning
[*] And so on…
[/list]

Join our discord to give suggestions and to report some bugs.
[url=https://discord.gg/6n4x6rnbs3]Discord[/url]

notes.title: What I’m working on
notes.content:
First of all, thank you all for supporting the game! I will be continuing developing the game since I really enjoyed working on this game and want to improve and give more to the players.

Here are some of the features that I’m working on:

[list]
[*]Special Machine upon Board Generation - These machines are placed on the board upon generation. I want to emphasize more the board generation of the game and this is one of the addition to encourage players to generate and look for an optimal board for them.
[*]Special Boards - These boards will give more identity to the tiers and gives more variety for the boards.
[*]Endgame Board - This one will give players more challenge upon reaching the endgame phase of the game.
[*]Quality of Life Improvements - One of the requested improvements is players want to see how fast are they gaining certain resource.
[*]Bug fixes - There are some minor bugs that I’ll include in the update as well to make the experience smoother.
[/list] 

Note that these are just what I’m working on. The list could change after playtesting but I’ll be focusing on board generation for the upcoming update.

Thank you again all for supporting the game! You can join the discord and give suggestions there.
[url=https://discord.gg/6n4x6rnbs3]Discord[/url]
